endorsements.quote: Patients retain control over their personal health information, while other stakeholders can access anonymized or aggregated data for approved purposes.

unlisted_practices: Grant patients ownership only over their personal health data.
Adopt co-ownership of health data among patients, providers, researchers, and AI developers, with specific rights and responsibilities based on each party's contribution.
Establish limitations and exceptions on health data ownership rights for stakeholders to balance their interests.
Establish transparent governance policies and procedures for health data that ensure equitable access, prevent misuse, and resolve conflicts among stakeholders.
Clarify health data ownership from a legal perspective to incentivize high-quality generation, dissemination, and use of medical data for AI development.

screen.reason: This paper presents a conceptual governance framework (Collaborative Healthcare Data Ownership framework) addressing data ownership and ethical AI governance in integrative health care.
